concealed-insertion.title: Concealed Insertion
concealed-insertion.text:
{{Infobox Booster
|title=Concealed Insertion
|image=Concealed Insertion Booster Icon.svg
|description=Equips Hellpods to deploy smokescreens on impact, obscuring Helldiver deployment.
|source=[[Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond#Page 3|Redacted Regiment]] <small>{{Tooltip|P3|Page 3}}</small>
|cost={{Currency|Medals|40}}
|order=18
}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Boosters|Booster]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. When equipped, [[Hellpod|Hellpods]] emits smoke on impact.

== Description ==
Concealed Insertion is a booster that causes all [[Hellpod|Hellpods]] (manned or unmanned) to deploy a short burst of smoke on impact, obscuring the area around the drop site and concealing Helldivers and equipment.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} Booster is unlocked on the third page of the [[Redacted Regiment Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}.

== Tactical Information ==
When a player is in smoke, enemies can only see them if they are less than 10m away, the minimum view distance. The smoke from Concealed Insertion applies to all Hellpods. It is useful if reinforcing closeby to enemies, as the player has time to escape before being spotted. The smoke helps to protect the Helldiver while using certain mission stratagems, such as when activating [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbombs]], grabbing [[Resupply|resupplies]], and saluting the [[Super Earth Flag]]. The [[Extraction|extraction beacon]], being called down immediately after the main objective is completed, is also temporarily obscured by smoke. Nearby enemies are alerted to any stratagem, so concealment when grabbing [[support weapons]] is also useful.

dead-sprint.title: Dead Sprint
dead-sprint.text:
{{Infobox Booster | title= {{PAGENAME}} | image= Dead Sprint Booster Icon.svg | description= Allows Helldivers to keep sprinting even when they are out of stamina, draining their health instead. | source= [[Truth Enforcers Premium Warbond#Page_1|Truth Enforcers]] {{Tooltip|P1|Page 1}} | cost= {{Currency|Medals|35}} | order=13 }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Boosters|Booster]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. When equipped, all Helldivers will be able to keep sprinting after they're exhausted, though it will eat though your HP. == Description == Dead Sprint allows Helldivers to cross longer stretches of land without using Stims or interrupting their sprint to regain their stamina. When used outside of combat, Dead Sprint saves time and potential Stims by allowing Helldivers to continue sprinting, allowing their health to drain and only using a Stim by the end of their hike from point A to B. It also condenses the amount of time spent sprinting in a situation where one was going to use a Stim regardless. In active conflict, it effectively allows Helldivers to kite enemies without stopping so long as their health allows for it, in a way trading potential enemy attacks for the minor chip damage inflicted by the booster. == Procurement == The {{PAGENAME}} Booster is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Truth Enforcers Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|35}}. == Tactical Information == * Drains approximately 3.6%https://youtu.be/k6xWwrmbyeU?si=YL837rqSFjV5rOKb&t=116 health (or ~1% with [[Vitality Enhancement]]) per second spent sprinting. * Allows 25 seconds of continuous sprinting once out of stamina, and stops once health reaches 5%.https://youtu.be/k6xWwrmbyeU?si=oEZGVQwoL_o5Aauu&t=106 * Dead Sprint won't activate when below the 5% health threshold, and does not have the ability to kill Helldivers should their health reach 1. * Vitality Enhancement greatly reduces the health drain incurred from Dead Sprint, allowing for 142 seconds of total sprint once out of stamina.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=25dwXN2Xywg

localization-confusion.title: Localization Confusion
localization-confusion.text:
{{Infobox Booster
| title= {{PAGENAME}}
| image= Localization Confusion Booster Icon.svg
| description= Increases the time between enemy encounters.
| source= [[Cutting Edge Premium Warbond#Page_1|Cutting Edge]] <small>{{Tooltip|P1|Page 1}}</small>
| cost= {{Currency|Medals|18}}
| order=8
}}

== Description ==
Localization Confusion is a Booster in Helldivers 2. When equipped, the time between the call for spawned enemy encounters/reinforcements (in the form of [[Bug Breach|Bug Breaches]], or Incoming Dropships) will be increased. This increased time gives Helldivers more breathing room, allowing them to react more to the incoming [[enemies]].

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} Booster is unlocked on the 1st page of the [[Cutting Edge Premium Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|18}}.

== Tactical Information ==
<nowiki>~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~</nowiki>

<big>'''**It should be noted that Localization Confusion <u>DOES NOT</u> affect the [[Spawn Mechanics|spawn mechanics]] or rate of [[enemy]] patrol spawning!!**'''</big>

Localization Confusion '''<u>DOES NOT</u>''' delay the time for the reinforcements to arrive once an encounter event occurs nor does it reduce the amount of reinforcements that respond to the call.

<nowiki>~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~</nowiki>

* An ''encounter'' (reinforcement call) is another name for a ''bot drop'', ''bug breach'', or ''incoming Illuminate ships''.
** There is an internal timer that starts when an encounter is triggered, ranging anywhere from around 2-5 minutes depending on difficulty. This timer acts as a cooldown period and must be completed before another encounter can be triggered. The length of this timer is '''fixed''' and '''does not change''' during the length of the mission. 
*** <big>Localization Confusion increases the internal reinforcement/encounter timer's threshold by ~15% <ref name=":0">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I0jvtJKo4VE</ref><ref name=":1">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XtBduAfUwug&t=48s</ref></big>

* ''For example:''
** <u>''Without''</u> Localization Confusion equipped, the threshold for the reinforcement/encounter cooldown timer on [[Difficulty]] 9 as a solo diver is <u>2 minutes</u> and <u>~30 seconds</u>. <ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
** ''<u>With</u>'' Localization Confusion equipped, the threshold for the reinforcement/encounter cooldown timer on [[Difficulty]] 9 as a solo diver is <u>~2 minutes and 52.5 seconds</u>. <ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />
*** <big>I.E. Localization Confusion has been demonstrated to increase the encounter cooldown timer by ~22.5 seconds as a solo diver on [[Difficulty]] 9.</big>

muscle-enhancement.title: Muscle Enhancement
muscle-enhancement.text:
{{Infobox Booster
| title= {{PAGENAME}}
| image= Muscle Enhancement Booster Icon.svg
| description= Allows Helldivers to traverse difficult terrain with ease.
| source= [[Helldivers Mobilize! Warbond#Page_9|Helldivers Mobilize!]] <small>{{Tooltip|P9|Page 9}}</small>
| cost= {{Currency|Medals|70}}
| order=5
}}

== Description ==
'''Muscle Enhancement''' is a [[Boosters|Booster]] in [[Helldivers 2]]. When equipped, all [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] will move faster in more difficult [[terrain]] and [[Environmental Hazards|environmental effects]].

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} Booster is unlocked on the 9th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|70}}.

== Tactical Information ==

* '''Muscle Enhancement''' reduces the slow effect placed upon a Helldiver when they traverse through these conditions: <ref name=":0">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Og4stcl48tE&t=317s</ref>
** [[Sandstorms]]
** [[Blizzards]]
** Water
** Snow
** Mud
** [[Flora|Foliage]]/[[Flora]]
** [[Automaton Barbed Wire|Barbed Wire]]
*Additionally, '''Muscle Enhancement''' reduces the strength of the slow effect induced by [[Status_Effects#Acid_Splash|Acid status]] from:
**Acid-based melee and ranged attacks from Terminids
**Acid explosions upon death of certain Terminids
**Acid explosions caused by triggering [[Bug Mine|Bug Mines]]

* '''Muscle Enhancement''' <u>DOES NOT</u> provide any benefit whatsoever when traversing: <ref name=":0" />
** Sand (Terrain without weather effect)
** Incline Surfaces (i.e. hills)
** Vaulting/Climbing
** [[Tremors]]

== Change History ==
{{Change History Head}}{{Change History Update|1.002.001|changes=
Change
* Increased the bonus gained by the Muscle Enhancement Booster by 40%.
}}

stamina-enhancement.title: Stamina Enhancement
stamina-enhancement.text:
{{Infobox Booster
| title= {{PAGENAME}}
| image= Stamina Enhancement Booster Icon.svg
| description= Increases all Helldivers' stamina capacity and recovery.
| source= [[Helldivers Mobilize! Warbond#Page_7|Helldivers Mobilize!]] <small>{{Tooltip|P7|Page 7}}</small>
| cost= {{Currency|Medals|75}}
| order=4
}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Boosters|Booster]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. When equipped, all [[Helldiver]]s will have increased stamina capacity and stamina recovery, allowing for longer sprinting times, and more physically-taxing movements.

== Description ==
Stamina Enhancement is a booster that reduces continuous stamina drain from sprinting and sliding by 22.5% and increases stamina regeneration rate by 30% for all Helldivers, improving their mobility when sprinting and maneuvering around obstacles.

This allows Helldivers to travel long distances more quickly, aiding in map exploration and objective completion.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} Booster is unlocked on the 7th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|75}}.

== Tactical Information ==
* Stamina Enhancement does not reduce the fixed stamina costs of diving and sliding.
* The {{PAGENAME}} booster is ideal for traversing larger maps, as the increased stamina will allow Helldivers to move across the map quicker by allowing for longer sprinting.
* In some [[Biomes]], it is helpful to bring a [[Muscle Enhancement|Muscle Enhancement Booster]] in addition to the Stamina Enhancement to more easily traverse adverse terrain such as mud, snow, and shallow water.
* Planets that are affected by the [[Intense Heat]] condition will reduce a Helldiver's maximum Stamina by half. Bringing the Stamina Enhancement Booster to these planets can help mitigate this effect.
* While this booster is great for all missions, it can be especially useful in [[Blitz Search And Destroy|Blitz: Search and Destroy]] missions, where speed is necessary to quickly move across a map. Due to the short mission time limit, longer sprints are necessary to reach [[Automaton Outpost|Automaton Outposts]], [[Bug Nest]]s, and [[Warp Ship|Illuminate Warp Ships]] while keeping pace with the mission timer.
** This necessity can alternatively be met with stratagems that enable faster movement such as the [[LIFT-850 Jump Pack]] or the [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI]].

uav-recon-booster.title: UAV Recon Booster
uav-recon-booster.text:
{{Infobox Booster
| title= {{PAGENAME}}
| image= UAV Recon Booster Booster Icon.svg
| description= Increases all Helldivers' effective radar range.
| source= [[Helldivers Mobilize! Warbond#Page_6|Helldivers Mobilize!]] <small>{{Tooltip|P6|Page 6}}</small>
| cost= {{Currency|Medals|40}}
| order=3
}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Boosters|Booster]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. When equipped, all [[Helldiver]]s will have increased effective radar range, allowing for easier recon of terrain.

== Description ==
The {{PAGENAME}} will increases radar distance by approximately 50%, giving every Helldiver a greater scanning range. This scanning range is shown on the mini-map, which allows Helldivers to locate patrolling enemies faster. These scans are not visible to fellow squadmates, so coordination is essential in alerting fellow Helldivers.

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} is unlocked on the 6th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|40}}.

== Tactical Information ==
* The {{PAGENAME}} booster is suited for [[Stealth]] tactics, where a Helldiver is trying to avoid detection. 
** This is further supplemented by using the [[Armor Passives#Scout|Scout Armor Passive]], as Helldivers are harder to detect and can see enemies locations by marking a position on the map.
* When using [[Armor_Passives#Scout|Scout]] or [[Armor_Passives#Unflinching|Unflinching]] armor passives, radar blips produced by markers placed on the minimap are affected by this booster.
* This booster will not work in missions with the [[Atmospheric Spores]] operation modifier.

vitality-enhancement.title: Vitality Enhancement
vitality-enhancement.text:
{{Infobox Booster
| title= {{PAGENAME}}
| image= Vitality Enhancement Booster Icon.svg
| description= Provides minor damage reduction from all sources for all Helldivers.
| source= [[Helldivers Mobilize! Warbond#Page_4|Helldivers Mobilize!]] <small>{{Tooltip|P4|Page 4}}</small>
| cost= {{Currency|Medals|20}}
| order=2
}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Boosters|Booster]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. When equipped, all [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] will be more resistant to damage and injury.

== Description ==
The {{PAGENAME}} booster is a support booster that is designed to increase survivability when taking damage. When equipped, all Helldivers in the squad will become more resistant to damage (reduces damage taken by 10%), allowing a Helldiver to have more effective health and reduce the occurrence of limb injuries. 
<!--Unclear if Booster increases limb health or ignores first instance of injury.  -->

== Procurement ==
The {{PAGENAME}} Booster is unlocked on the 4th page of the [[Helldivers Mobilize Warbond]] for {{Currency|Medals|20}}.

== Tactical Information ==
* {{PAGENAME}} is a good booster for any mission type, as increased resistance allows for a Helldiver to stay in the fight longer, as well as not needing to use as many Stims to recover from limb injuries (by reducing the chance of injury outright).
* This booster works well in more defensive missions, where the squad is required to hunker down in an area, as the limited mobility means there will be more incoming attacks. The increased survivability increases the chance of survival, as well as less reliance on [[Supplies#Resupply Box|Resupplies]].
* When combined with [[Dead Sprint]], health drain caused by running is reduced from approximately 3.6% health to ~1%.
* When using the [[LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle]], the amount of self-damage taken from firing the weapon is decreased by a flat amount. When combined with [[Inflammable]] this prevents the weapon from dealing self-damage until 51% heat is reached.
** The inflammable reduces all Fire-damage by 75%, reducing the 10-Fire-damage/second (26-50% heat) to 2.5 and 20 damage/second (51-90% heat) to 5. Vitality Booster reduces these damages by 1 and 2 respectively. Heavy Armor (150 AR) Reduces the damage by 2.5 and 5 respectively.
* When combined with [[Advanced Filtration]] (AF) and Heavy Armor (HA), the Helldiver becomes virtually immune to lingering [[Status Effects#Gas|Gas]]-damage.
** The Advanced Filtration alone reduces the Gas-damage/second from 25 to 5 (by 80%). By itself both Heavy Armor (150 AR) and Vitality Booster (VB) would reduce the Gas-damage by 6.25 and 2.50-points respectively.
